mapper.select: SELECT api_key_name, encrypted_value, updated_by, updated_at FROM api_key_settings ORDER BY api_key_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_key_settings (api_key_name, encrypted_value, updated_by) VALUES (#{apiKeyName}, #{encryptedValue}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (api_key_name) DO UPDATE SET encrypted_value = EXCLUDED.encrypted_value, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
